title: Design decisions
text: D-001 (2026-11-20) Package name trainingmodels. Checked pak::pkg_name_check: valid, free CRAN Bioconductor. D-002 (2026-11-18) First version scope: daily-series core, load descriptors, Banister impulse-response model. Later: Busso variable dose-response, fitness delay, Kalman filter, Bayesian version, DLNM via dlnm package (wrapped, reimplemented). D-003 (2026-11-18) Every formula verified source implementation; verification source recorded per method. D-004 (2026-11-18) Every method documented limitations (identifiability, wide intervals, assumptions), computation. D-005 (2026-11-18) Public repository day one; issues, pull requests releases; AI use disclosed (see AI_USAGE.md). D-006 (2026-11-18) pkgdown site start, one article per method. D-007 (2026-11-18) Numerical tests published examples independent reference implementation. D-008 (2026-11-18) Code, documentation commits English. D-009 (2026-11-19) package code written verified formulas; third-party code used external reference tests, never copied. D-010 (2026-11-20) bib/ folder (copyrighted papers) never committed. D-011 (2026-11-24) Impulse-response functions implement timing conventions found literature, selected argument same_day_load: “exclude” (sum n-1; Busso & Chalencon 2023) “include” (Morton et al. 1990, Eqs. 4-5). Reason: two forms equivalent use; see MODELS.md, M-01. D-012 (2026-11-24) default same_day_load = "exclude". Every fitted object stores prints convention, gains fitted one convention comparable . D-013 (2026-11-24) MODELS.md model registry single source truth formulas, verification sources, reference values literature discrepancies. first version (entries M-01 M-09) approved author 2026-11-24. D-014 (2026-11-25) package app ship pre-built example datasets modelled published studies; simulated labelled simulated. impulse-response models share one data format (daily load plus performance days). app explains format variables collect users upload data. D-015 (2026-11-25) Every day one three states: training (load > 0), rest (load = 0), missing (load available). Days row athlete’s first last date treated rest default, message listing many filled, warning 7 consecutive days filled. user can request days treated missing instead. D-016 (2026-11-25) Missing loads never silently replaced. Descriptors return NA windows containing missing day. Impulse-response models refuse run series missing loads unless user explicitly chooses fill ; first version option zero. D-017 (2026-11-25) data file may contain several athletes (optional identifier column) several load columns; analysis uses one load column chosen user. D-018 (2026-11-26) second model family, training load -> injury, enters package version 0.3: distributed lag non-linear models (wrapping dlnm), piece-wise exponential additive mixed model cumulative effects Zumeta-Olaskoaga et al. 2025 (wrapping pammtools mgcv), tools evaluate predictions (discrimination, calibration). Neural-network structural-equation approaches implemented. D-019 (2026-11-26) Everything related acute:chronic workload ratio (ratios, EWMA-based loads, FWF matrices Matas-Bustos et al. 2025) lives author’s ACWR package. trainingmodels reimplement ; documentation refers ACWR. D-020 (2026-11-26) Window-based descriptors offer timing options same_day_load (“include”: window ends current day; “exclude”: ends previous day, Carey et al. 2017, Eq. 1). D-021 (2026-11-26) default descriptors same_day_load = "include". differs impulse-response default (D-012) must stated help every descriptor. D-022 (2026-11-26) Monotony strain: rolling 7-day window computed every day; rest days count load 0; loads window equal standard deviation 0 monotony strain NA. D-023 (2026-11-27) fitness-model (MODELS.md, M-03) included, option simulation function two-component model. Closes P-007. D-024 (2026-11-27) Half-life (tau x ln 2) shown printed output next time constant. Function arguments always time constants, never half-lives. Closes P-010. D-025 (2026-11-27) Initial fitness fatigue 0 default can set user simulation. Fitting (0.1.0) keep fixed 0 first version, documented limitation. Closes P-013. D-026 (2026-11-27) Characteristic times named words: time_to_recover time_to_peak (single session, M-05), time_of_minimum (constant daily training, M-04). NA, reason stated help, exist. function argument named t_n. Closes naming question MODELS.md, M-05.

title: trainingmodels 0.0.3
text: New simulate_banister() simulates Banister impulse-response model daily_load object parameters given user: fitness, fatigue predicted performance every day, within athlete. fitness-model option function (DECISIONS.md, D-023). timing conventions offered same_day_load, default "exclude" (D-012). title: trainingmodels 0.0.2
text: New srpe_load() computes session RPE load, RPE x duration (Foster 1998; Foster et al. 2001).
